name: Process profile: Within
abstract: Process profile of the live OGC API - Processes process `Within` (ZOO-Project, Geonovum testbed), with a process-type entry linking to its Implementation Profile. Static processDescription only, no execute/results/provenance.
description:
Process profile of the live OGC API - Processes process `Within` (ZOO-Project, Geonovum testbed): <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/Within>.

> This service shall return a true value if and only if the geometry InputEntity1 is spatially within geometry InputEntity2; that is if every point on InputEntity1 is also on InputEntity2.

(the process's own description, as served)

## Implementation Profile

Implements [`Within`](https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/within) (`generic-profiles.implementation-profile.within`, bblocks-generic-profiles).

Deployed inputs/outputs and the Implementation Profile's (`bindings` in `scripts/profiles.yaml`), with the data type each bound input/output inherits (`processDescription.inherited.json`):

| Deployed | Implementation Profile | Data type |
|---|---|---|
| `InputEntity1` | input `geometry1` | `geometry` |
| `InputEntity2` | input `geometry2` | `geometry` |
| `Result` | output `result` | `boolean` |

## Examples

- `processDescription.json`: the processDescription as served, ZOO-Project-internal fields removed.
- `processDescription.inherited.json`: the same with what OGC 14-065r1 Table 21 has it inherit at the Implementation (instance level): keywords and metadata references to its profiles, and the data type of each bound input/output.
- `process-type.json`: its candidate process-type entry.

examples.title: Source (referenced)
examples.content: The processDescription is fetched from the live service, not copied: <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/Within>.

examples.title: processDescription
examples.content: Live OGC API - Processes processDescription, normalised (ZOO-Project-internal fields dropped).

examples.title: processDescription with its inheritance (Implementation, instance level)
examples.content: The same processDescription as OGC 14-065r1 Table 21 wants it at the Implementation (instance level) of `https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/within`: the Implementation Profile's keywords (E) on the process and on each bound input/output, and, per footnote a, its list of metadata references to superior profiles extended with a Table 22 `implementation` reference to the Implementation Profile -- on the process only. Each bound input/output keeps its Implementation Profile counterpart's reference to the Generic Profile input/output (`generic-input`/`-output`) and adds one to that counterpart itself (`<Implementation Profile>/inputs/<name>`, `/outputs/<name>`, `implementation-input`/`-output`): roles defined by bblocks-generic-profiles, since Table 22 only names whole profiles. Each bound input/output also carries the `dataType` of that counterpart, a concept of bblocks-data-types. Which deployed input/output is which Implementation Profile one is `bindings` in scripts/profiles.yaml; inputs/outputs bound to none are the deployment's own additions (footnote b). Not what the deployment serves today (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Q-TABLE21-INSTANCE).

examples.title: process-type entry
examples.content: Registered ActivityType OWL class `https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/sqlmm/within` (`ospd.process-profiles.process-type`), proposed by GeoLabs and awaiting a register decision, linking to its Implementation Profile.
